Full screen on iPhone 📱

iPhone doesn't let web pages go full screen, but you can add the elf to your home screen and it will open full screen like an app:

  1. Tap the Share button ⬆️ at the bottom of Safari
  2. Choose Add to Home Screen
  3. Open Criw Cicio Elf from your home screen
